### Kroger to Host 2026 Investor Day on October 20, 2026


September 18, 2026


CINCINNATI


, Sept. 18, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- The Kroger Co. (NYSE: KR) announced today it will host its 2026 Investor Day on Tuesday, October 20, 2026.


The event will feature presentations and a question-and-answer session with members of Kroger's executive leadership team, including Greg Foran, Chief Executive Officer, and David Kennerley, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer. Management will provide an update on Kroger's strategic priorities and long-term financial outlook.


Due to limited capacity, in-person attendance is by invitation only and advanced registration is required. The live webcast of the event is scheduled to begin at 9:00 a.m. ET and is expected to conclude at approximately 12:00 p.m. ET. All interested parties are invited to access the webcast at **[ir.kroger.com](http://ir.kroger.com/)** under **Events & Presentations** .


An on-demand replay of the webcast and presentation materials will be available on Kroger's investor relations website following the event.


**About Kroger**


[The Kroger Co](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776943-1&h=475085980&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.thekrogerco.com%2F&a=The+Kroger+Co) . (NYSE: KR) is one of America's largest retailers, serving more than 11 million customers daily through a digital shopping experience and retail food stores under a variety of banner names. With more than 400,000 associates across our family of companies, Kroger is committed to providing America with affordable, great-tasting food and creating #ZeroHungerZeroWaste communities. To learn more about us, visit our[newsroom](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776943-1&h=1776419971&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.thekrogerco.com%2Fir-news&a=newsroom) and[investor relations site](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776943-1&h=3565422700&u=https%3A%2F%2Fir.kroger.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&a=investor+relations+site) .
